followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: My choice was capability-driven. The query is benign expository writing with an instruction-following constraint ("be coherent, don't waffle"), and no harm-adjacent content is involved—so the task-preference distinctions between the two models (the only meaningful behavioral difference documented) don't apply. That leaves raw capability as the tiebreaker, and Dunlin is clearly stronger: it leads on IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6) and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4), both directly relevant to producing a tight, well-structured response, plus higher Creative Generation and Summarization internal scores. So Dunlin is the better fit.
